children: Retail sales in Bulgaria rose by 5.9% year-on-year in August 2026, following a six-month low of 5.6% in the previous month.

Activity increased in automotive fuels and lubricants (8.3% vs 6.6% in July) and non-food goods, except automotive fuels and lubricants (4.2% vs 4.1%), driven largely by higher sales in computer and communication equipment and other consumer goods (4.6% vs 1.9%), and mail order, telephone or internet (28.1% vs 22.5%).
Moreover, sales growth remained steady in food, beverages, and tobacco (at 7.5%).
On a monthly basis, retail activity grew by 0.3% in August, rebounding from a downwardly revised 0.3% drop in the preceding period.

title: Bulgaria Retail Sales Growth Accelerates in August
